text:
Ravi: FYI handoff — primary is @Asha for the next 4h. APAC started paging at ~00:10 UTC, p99 generation up, some kv-cache OOMs. tagging runbooks below.
incident-bot: [ALERT] pager: model-serving-high-p99 (severity: p2) — 3 open pages, routed to #eng-oncall. link: https://incidents.redwood/internal/INC-2026-314
Asha: taking primary. quick summary of customer impact? is this user-facing or internal evals?
Ravi: user-facing for a subset of enterprise tenants in ap-southeast. errors are 502s for long prompts and timeouts on streaming. not global yet but p99 spike is ~7-8s.
Tom: saw KV cache OOMs on serving nodes — logs show repeated eviction thrash. might be cascade: KV misses -> full context recompute -> higher token compute -> p99.
Priya: if KV is thrashing, short-term mitigation = drop large-context routing -> route to small-window variant + enable prefix cache hit fallback. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/serving/kv-thrash
Asha: ok doing quick checklist: 1) mark primary/secondary 2) assess impact + comms 3) attempt small-model fallback 4) scale pool if needed 5) warm restart a node if bad. anyone have the CLI commands?
Tom: small-model route flip (dry):
```bash
redwood route update --route model-gen --variant gpt-small-quant --dry-run
```
then remove --dry-run to actually flip.
Priya: scale dedicated pool (if reserved capacity available):
```bash
redwood capacity scale --pool apac-serving --replicas +2 --reason "p99 mitigation"
```
If no capacity, enable fallback routing to region us-west.
ops-sre-bot: @Asha, suggested runbook step: "If p99 > 5s for 15m, enable model-variant fallback and notify product". See https://runbooks.redwood/internal/serving/p99-fallback
Asha: Doing variant flip dry-run now. Will monitor for 3m. also tagging @Tom to watch KV metrics.
Tom: KV eviction rate spiked 3x at 00:07 UTC, memory pressure on nodes svc-13/14. I recommend cordon and rolling restart of svc-14 after traffic shift.
Ravi: note — customer-facing comms: set status page to "degraded performance" for ap-southeast tenants only. PR for status: https://status.redwood/incidents/314/edit
Priya: quick pointer: if variant flip fails or increases latency, immediate rollback cmd: `redwood route rollback --route model-gen`
Asha: variant flip completed (no dry-run). observed p50 unchanged, p95 down, p99 trending down from 7.9s -> 3.8s in 6m.
incident-bot: [UPDATE] INC-2026-314: mitigation: model-variant-fallback applied by Asha. Please continue monitoring for 30m.
Tom: cordoned svc-14 and draining. restarting after 30s. keeping 2 nodes live to avoid capacity cliff.
ops-sre-bot: Suggest adding a temporary cache size limit to prevent OOM recurrence:
```yaml
# config snippet
kv_cache:
  max_entries: 250000
  ttl_seconds: 3600
```
Asha: applied cache limit (config push) to apac pool. watching evictions.
Priya: checklist for handoff note to next shift: - primary: Asha - secondary: Tom - current mitigations: variant fallback applied, pool +2 attempted (no extra reserved), svc-14 restart, kv cache limit set - actions pending: observe for 30m, consider permanent quantized variant if stable - runbooks: kv-thrash, p99-fallback, model-rollback links above
Ravi: TY — also note customer list to notify: corp-acme, beta-dataworks. Priya can you open a post-incident ticket?
Priya: opened INC-2026-314-postmortem (#PM-314). added timeline + logs.
Asha: p99 at 3.2s now, error rate back to baseline for most tenants. I'll keep primary until 00:30 UTC then hand to Tom. leaving these quick runbook links in the handoff. :thumbsup:
Tom: I'll take over at 00:30. will re-check warm cache hit ratio and traffic split. if anything flares call me on pager.
incident-bot: [CLOSE_TO_MONITOR] INC-2026-314 moved to monitoring (owner: Asha).
Ravi: handoff notes for Tom: captured commands executed + configs in the postmortem. main thing: don't flip back the variant until warm cache hit ratio > 50% or p99 below 2s for 15m.
Tom: ack. adding to my watchlist.
Asha: handing over to @Tom — primary swap in 5. leaving runbook links pinned in the thread. good job team. :raised_hands:
Tom: thanks — taking primary. final note: if p99 creeps above 4s, enable emergency soft-shutdown of long-prompt queue (runbook step) to protect latency for short prompts.
Ravi: handoff complete.
ops-sre-bot: log: handoff recorded, INC-2026-314 mitigation steps appended to incident record.
Asha: closing my window, leaving monitoring notes in the ticket.
Tom: will send a brief morning summary in #eng-oncall-ops after 00:45 UTC.
